pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions display complex, stellate geometries with highly irregular, jagged edges. Individual patches vary in size and exhibit deep, acute-angled indentations.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream-colored pathways separating dark patches. Pixel thickness is non-uniform, with frequent junction nodes where multiple pathways intersect.
